title: Embedded locally finite free ell-full submodules
statement: Let $(C,J)$ be a site, $R$ a sheaf of rings, and $L$ a sheaf of $R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume the sheafification and locally-bijective comparison structures for abelian sheaves on each slice site that are used by the module-sheaf local-freeness predicate. Fix an integer $\ell\geq0$. An embedded $\ell$-lattice in $L$ consists of an $R$-subpresheaf $N\subseteq L$ whose underlying presheaf is a sheaf, which is locally free of finite, possibly varying rank (including zero), and which is locally $\ell$-full: for each object $T$ and $x\in L(T)$ there is a covering sieve $S$ on $T$ such that, for every $f:V\to T$ in $S$, some $n\geq0$ satisfies $\ell^n x|_V\in N(V)$. The exponent may depend on $f$ and $x$. The embedding is the actual family of submodules of $L(T)$, not an abstract module up to isomorphism. In the coefficient-comparison application, $L$ is rational, so multiplication by $\ell$ is invertible on $L$; the last condition expresses fullness after sheaf localization.
